final: WITH matched AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.timespan, o.recordvault FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin rm ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault), counts AS (SELECT timespan, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matched GROUP BY timespan), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total, COUNT(*) as num_timespans FROM counts) SELECT c.timespan, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total as share, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total - 1.0 / t.num_timespans as diff_from_avg FROM counts c, totals t ORDER BY c.timespan
